title: Tropical storm moving inland over Kershaw County
summary: A hurricane weakens to a tropical storm as it moves inland, like Helene in 2024. NWS issues a Tropical Storm Warning and a Flood Watch. Shows two hazards at once.

alerts.headline: TROPICAL STORM WARNING IN EFFECT
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. * WIND: Tropical storm force winds of 40 to 55 mph with gusts to 70 mph are expected.
* FLOODING RAIN: Additional rainfall of 4 to 6 inches, locally higher.
* TORNADO: A few tornadoes are possible.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. Listen to local officials for recommended preparedness actions, including possible evacuation. Ensure you have an emergency kit and a plan.

alerts.headline: FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT THROUGH SATURDAY EVENING
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. * WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be possible.
* WHERE...Kershaw and Lee counties.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood Warnings.
